description_en: Obtain the outbound call job progress by instance ID and job ID.
description_zh: 根据实例ID、任务ID获取外呼任务进展
name: GetAiOutboundTaskProgress

parameters.description_en: The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID. You can obtain it in the Instance Management section of the left-side navigation pane in the [Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview).
parameters.description_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在[智能联络中心控制台](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取。

parameters.description_en:
Job ID.

You can invoke the [CreateAiOutboundTask](~~312260~~) API and check the **Data** field in the response, or invoke the [GetAiOutboundTaskList](~~2718026~~) API and check the **TaskId** field in the response.
parameters.description_zh:
任务ID。

可调用[CreateAiOutboundTask](~~312260~~)接口，查看返回参数中的**Data**，或者调用[GetAiOutboundTaskList](~~2718026~~)接口，查看返回参数中的**TaskId**。
